experience.description: AI helpdesk for B2B companies: an AI agent that answers their customers on WhatsApp, web chat and email, with a shared inbox and help center. In production with paying customers.
bullets: Built and operate the backend, AI agent and AWS infrastructure end to end, shipping 240+ production releases in 7 months across 3 services behind a 6,500+ test suite and a PR-gated CI/CD pipeline.

Built the agentic support system: a Claude tool-calling loop over each company's knowledge base (RAG) and its own APIs, with guardrails and human handoff, answering customers on WhatsApp, web chat and email.
Designed the evaluation pipeline that gates every AI change (LLM-as-judge on real conversations, retrieval benchmarks, blind model comparisons), used to choose, tune and migrate models.
Implemented the Model Context Protocol on both sides: an MCP server with its own OAuth 2.1 authorization server, and an MCP client that connects customers' own tools to the agent.
Built channel and business integrations as a separate service: WhatsApp Business as a verified Meta Tech Provider, Slack, email, Shopify, HubSpot, and public APIs for Zapier and Make.

Replaced Celery in production with ArdiQ, my own Rust-core task queue, which now runs every background job.
Run recurring security audits covering multi-tenant isolation, access control, container hardening and PII scrubbing.
